title: Telemetry-source valuation and leakage-audited explainable alerts on RT-IoT2022
description: Reproducible study of a two-pass explainable random-forest detector on the public RT-IoT2022 dataset: leakage audit (row-index column, regression on class codes), class-balanced SHAP feature selection, exact Shapley attribution of macro F1 to five telemetry sources over all 32 source combinations, degraded-telemetry evaluation with fallback models, and confidence-based review routing. Includes code, raw per-split results, summary tables and figures. The dataset is not redistributed.
